name: What are the biggest mistakes homeowners make with room additions?

mainEntity.name: What are the biggest mistakes homeowners make when planning room additions in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What are the biggest mistakes homeowners make when planning room additions in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common room addition mistakes are easy to avoid with the right process. Homeowners often start with design before confirming zoning and structural feasibility, which can waste time and money. Another common problem is budgeting only for visible construction and forgetting engineering, permits, utility changes, and contingency costs. Some homeowners also choose a bid without comparing scope, which leads to surprises later when items are excluded. Poor layout planning is another issue, especially when the new room does not connect well to the rest of the home or when circulation becomes awkward. In Los Angeles, permit and inspection complexity make it even more important to plan carefully. The safest approach is to confirm feasibility, get a detailed scope, compare multiple bids, and make sure the addition supports both daily living and resale value.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are underestimating cost, skipping feasibility checks, ignoring permit requirements, choosing the wrong contractor, and designing the addition without thinking about how it connects to the rest of the house. These mistakes often lead to delays, budget overruns, and awkward layouts.
